depends_on.name: coordinate_system_id
depends_on.documentation: The coordinate system the coordinates are in. REQUIRED: a position with no coordinate system is only numbers (item 9).

fields.name: value
fields.documentation: Where something is: coordinates[k] along the coordinate system's dimensions[k], in that dimension's spacing units (metres = coordinate x spacing). Many positions (centroids, outline vertices) run along a dimension over the things positioned. One entry, or a list of them along the value's `dimensions`, whose `covariates` say what each entry is (#73 review D1; `keys` until 2026-10-22).

fields.name: approximate
fields.documentation: True when the coordinates are approximate (Jess Haley 2026-11-09 [tenet audit 6 8 11], did_v2_go_forward_class_audit.md).

fields.name: tolerance
fields.documentation: The bound on these coordinates: each true coordinate lies between `coordinate - minus` and `coordinate + plus`, in the coordinate system's spacing units, for the whole set. ABSENT means no tolerance is stated. A bound, not a standard deviation (CHANGE 7; Jess Haley 2026-11-09 [tenet audit 6 8 11], did_v2_go_forward_class_audit.md).

fields.name: minus
fields.documentation: How far BELOW the stated value the true value may lie, in the canonical unit (meters) (for a time: how much EARLIER). Non-negative.

fields.name: plus
fields.documentation: How far ABOVE the stated value the true value may lie, in the canonical unit (meters) (for a time: how much LATER). Non-negative.
